senses.gloss:
ववन्वस्, वान्, उषी, वत्, Ved. one who has
desired or asked.

वव वव, अस्, m. the first of the eleven
Karaṇas or astrological divisions of time.

वाव वाव, ind. (i. e. probably वा + एव),
verily, indeed, (sometimes used in a question.)

ववर्जुषी ववर्जुषी, f. (see rt. वृज्), Ved.
one who has effaced or atoned for.

वव्र वव्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वृ), Ved.
surrounding, enveloping, (Sāy. = वृण्वत्); (अस्), m.
darkness, (Sāy. = वारक); a cavern, abyss, (Sāy.
= गर्त); a hole, well (= कूप, according to
Naigh. III. 23).

वव्रि, इस्, m. an enveloping shape or form (ac-
cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 116, 10, V. 74, 5),
any form (according to Naigh. III. 7 = रूप); N.
of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 19, (his
patronymic is Ātreya.)

वव्रिवस्, वान्, उषी, वत्, Ved. one who has en-
veloped or obstructed.

वावदत् वावदत्, अत्, अती, अत् (fr. Intens. of
rt. वद्), Ved. uttering or causing loud sounds.

वावदूक, अस्, आ, अम्, talking much, gabbling,
prattling; eloquent.
—वावदूक-ता, f. or वावदूक-
त्व, अम्, n. garrulity, loquaciousness.

वावद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, talking much, uttering
loud sounds.

वावय वावय, अस्, m. a sort of basil, Ocy-
mum Sanctum.

वावशान 1. वावशान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the
Intens. of rt. वश्; for 2. see below), Ved. eagerly
desiring or longing for, ardently loving.

2. वावशान, अस्, आ, अम् (anom. intens. part.),
Ved. roaring aloud, sounding, crackling, (according
to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 26, 2 = शब्दायमान.)

वावहि वावहि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. the Intens. of
rt. 1. वह्), bearing or carrying much.

वावातृ वावातृ, ता, m., Ved. one who is
favourable to or serves another, a worshipper, (in the
Pada text ववातृ.)
वावुट वावुट, अस्, m. a raft, boat, vessel.

वावृत् वावृत् (rather to be regarded as
an old Intens. of rt. 3. वृत्, q. v.), cl.
4. A. वावृत्यते, &c., to choose, select, prefer, love,
like; to serve.
वावृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, chosen, selected, appointed.
वावृत्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, choosing, preferring.

वावृधान वावृधान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वृध्,
in the Pada-pāṭha ववृधान), Ved. growing, in-
creasing.

वावृधेन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be increased, (Sāy.
= वर्धनीय.)

वावशत्, अत्, अती, अत् (anom. intens. part.), Ved.
sounding or lowing loudly.
